about: Reference values for calibration. Every number keeps its source, season, game state and unit. Per-game values are for BOTH teams combined unless the field says per_team. NHL values are full-length games (60 min regulation + OT); Rink '95 regulation is 3 x 3 min of running clock. Compare shares and percentages directly; compare counts only after normalising to per-60-minutes-of-play, and treat even that as format-dependent.

hr_league.what: League averages per team per game: G, SA, SV%. SV% excludes empty-net goals.

nhl_realtime.what: NHL stats API team realtime report, regular season, summed over 32 teams: hits, blockedShots, giveaways, takeaways, missedShots, shots, totalShotAttempts, shotAttemptsBlocked, emptyNetGoals, gamesPlayed (2624 team-games = 1312 games).

nhl_summary.what: NHL stats API team summary, summed over 32 teams: wins, otLosses, goalsFor, winsInRegulation, regulationAndOtWins, winsInShootout, teamShutouts.

nhl_faceoffs.what: NHL stats API faceoff report; faceoffsWon summed over teams = faceoffs in the league.

edgehalla.what: Per game, both teams, all situations, regular season, from NHL play-by-play; shootouts excluded. Since 2023-24 blocks by the shooter's own teammate are logged (about 2.8 a game in 2025-26) and included in attempts.

dailyfaceoff_ot.what: 71.6% of 2024-25 overtimes were decided in OT (cross-check of the derived value).

goals_per_game.state: all situations, includes empty-net goals; NHL goalsFor credits the shootout winner

blocked_per_game.note: includes blocks by the shooter's teammate

pp_opportunities_per_team_game.state: power-play opportunities per team per game

unavailable.per_game_distributions: SDs, percentiles and histograms of NHL per-game counts need game-level data. The local nhl-dataset repo (MoneyPuck-style DuckDB, 2007-2025, team-by-game and shot-level tables with situation splits) has them, but no DuckDB reader is installed; installing one needs approval.
unavailable.conditional_rates: Shooting % by distance/angle/shot type, rebound rates and score effects come from the same shot table; not yet extracted.
unavailable.five_on_five: Rink '95 has no penalties, so its play is all even strength. NHL 5v5-only rates (Edgehalla reports about 96 attempts a game at 5v5 in 2024-25) are the better comparator for counts; only the all-situations totals above are sourced exactly.
unavailable.possession_and_passes: The NHL does not publish passes, completions or possession time; any reference would come from tracking data (NHL EDGE / Big Data Cup) and is not established here.
unavailable.nhl95: No reliable measured pacing data for NHL 95 (Genesis) was found: no published goals, shots or period-length statistics. Sega Retro documents a hidden 30-second-period option, which says nothing about default pacing. Measuring it would need timestamped event logging from gameplay footage.
